title: ChatServer configuration
description: config.json for the built-in chat pipelines. Custom registered adapters and tools require extending this schema.

$schema.description: Location of this JSON schema for editor validation and completion.

chats.description: Chat pipelines served by this process. An empty array runs no adapters.

modelReference.description: <provider>/<model id>, using the provider name and model ID from models.json. Model IDs may contain additional slashes.

filters.description: Filters evaluated in order. Omit or use [] to delegate to the reply model without running filters.

stt.description: Optional speech-to-text settings. Omit the entire object to ignore voice input.

model.description: Required <provider>/<model id> for audio/transcriptions. There is no fallback to messager.replier.

audioConversionCmd.description: Optional shell command converting {input} to {output} as WAV. Runs in an isolated temporary directory; converter must be installed on the ChatServer machine. Without it, original audio is uploaded.

name.description: Registered transport. WeChat is the built-in implementation.

persona.description: Optional replier identity, tone, and style. Omit for the default helpful assistant. Applies only to the replier; output-format and reply-length requirements still apply.
examples: A warm, lightly humorous friend who gives practical photography advice.

mainAccount.description: Exact sender ID authorized to use /status in a direct chat; usually wxid_..., not a display name.

tools.description: Application-managed replier tools. Omit to enable all four; [] disables tools. Duplicate entries are deduplicated.

baseUrl.description: agent-wechat HTTP(S) server root, without credentials, query, or fragment.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable containing the bearer token; takes precedence over tokenFile.

tokenFile.description: Fallback bearer-token file. Relative paths resolve against the config directory; expand ~ yourself.

chatIds.description: Chat IDs to monitor. Omit to monitor all chats; mainAccount is always included when configured.

pollIntervalMs.description: Delay after a completed poll, in milliseconds. Failed polls use exponential backoff.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for each WeChat REST request in milliseconds; independent of model timeouts.

bundleGapMs.description: Maximum timestamp gap between adjacent messages from the same sender, in milliseconds. Zero disables bundling.

oneOf.description: Shorthand ignore filter using the default <messager>_ignore file.

file.description: Ignore-list file; defaults to <messager>_ignore in the config directory. Relative paths resolve against that directory.

senderIds.description: Inline sender IDs combined with the file's IDs. Ignored messages are excluded before buffering and model processing.

instructions.description: Decision criteria for the filter model. Thinking is disabled for filter calls.
instructions.default: Allow messages that would benefit from an assistant response. Otherwise abstain.
